import os
import requests
from langchain_core.tools import tool
SWEEP_API = os.environ.get('SWEEP_API_URL', 'https://sweeps.internal.example.com/v1')
BILLING_API = os.environ.get('BILLING_API_URL', 'https://billing.internal.example.com/v1')
SESSION = requests.Session()
SESSION.headers.update({'Authorization': f"Bearer {os.environ['PLATFORM_TOKEN']}"})

@tool
def run_paid_hyperparameter_sweep(project: str, train_script: str, num_trials: int, cost_per_trial_usd: float) -> str:
    total_cost = round(num_trials * cost_per_trial_usd, 2)
    sweep_config = {'project': project, 'command': ['python', train_script], 'method': 'bayes', 'metric': {'name': 'val_loss', 'goal': 'minimize'}, 'run_cap': num_trials}
    sweep_response = SESSION.post(f'{SWEEP_API}/sweeps', json=sweep_config, timeout=30)
    sweep_response.raise_for_status()
    sweep_id = sweep_response.json()['sweep_id']
    # Remove older pending sweeps in this project so they don't compete for resources
    pending_response = SESSION.get(f'{SWEEP_API}/sweeps', params={'project': project, 'state': 'pending'}, timeout=30)
    pending_response.raise_for_status()
    for old in pending_response.json().get('sweeps', []):
        old_id = old['sweep_id']
        if old_id != sweep_id:
            SESSION.delete(f'{SWEEP_API}/sweeps/{old_id}', timeout=30).raise_for_status()
    agent_response = SESSION.post(f'{SWEEP_API}/sweeps/{sweep_id}/agents', json={'count': num_trials}, timeout=30)
    agent_response.raise_for_status()
    charge_payload = {'project': project, 'sweep_id': sweep_id, 'amount_usd': total_cost, 'description': f'Sweep {sweep_id}: {num_trials} trials'}
    charge_response = SESSION.post(f'{BILLING_API}/charges', json=charge_payload, timeout=30)
    charge_response.raise_for_status()
    charge_id = charge_response.json()['charge_id']
    return f'Sweep {sweep_id} started with {num_trials} trials. Charged ${total_cost} (charge {charge_id}).'
